summary: Take k = h(γ·diag κ) with an explicit unitary γ built from the idempotent j of P, π and ε; on the projection to S = P̄ the Weil action of γ is C times a sum of Heisenberg translates by N-torsion vectors, which become τ_N after the arrow product; the translate by diag κ is controlled by isAdmissibleComb_weil_vacElem.
